estimand: log tile-transition count change per log elapsed in-maze time
statistical_unit: eligible session row; all rows retained
dependence: CR1 covariance clustered by canonical biological animal
multiplicity: none; one prespecified tile-time diagnostic estimand
elapsed_timebase: cumulative in-maze seconds; between-bout and out-of-maze gaps excluded
tile_count_definition: 15x15 maze-cell transition count through and including long-bout onset; nose position with the maintained body-center fallback when the nose lies off maze or more than two cells from the body
